tools.name: search_founders
tools.description: Search approved Founderhood listings by city, country, category, or keyword. Returns public business profiles.

tools.name: list_cities
tools.description: List cities with approved founder listings and counts.

tools.name: get_founder
tools.description: Fetch one approved listing by its URL slug.

tools.name: submit_listing
tools.description: Submit a new business for human review. Same validation and rate limits as POST /api/submit. Requires founder consent.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_founder · Public sink: submit_listing.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_founder · Public sink: submit_listing

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
